title: Arrow isin fallback preserves numeric types and null matching
answers: Why does Series.isin raise on mixed values with PyArrow-backed dtypes?
How should ArrowExtensionArray.isin handle values PyArrow cannot box or cast?
Should NaN in isin values match an Arrow null or a non-null NaN?
body:
Symptom: Series.isin, DataFrame.isin, or Index.isin on PyArrow-backed dtypes raises for mixed-type candidates or oversized integers.
Root cause: pandas/core/arrays/arrow/array.py:ArrowExtensionArray.isin can fail during candidate boxing or pc.is_in casting with ArrowInvalid, ArrowTypeError, or OverflowError.
Fix pattern: Keep the Arrow fast path; catch these failures and compare non-null entries through algos.isin. Convert candidates to an object array, but retain the comparison array's native NumPy dtype for numeric types.
Constraints: In pandas/core/arrays/arrow/array.py:ArrowExtensionArray.isin, the fallback applies to these boxing/casting failures. Separate missing candidates before comparison: missing values, including NaN, match only Arrow nulls, never non-null NaN. Skipping this separation changes Arrow membership semantics.
applies: Membership checks implemented by ArrowExtensionArray.isin, including callers through Series, DataFrame, and Index.
